scenarios.prompt: A player freezes planning, queues commands for two actors, edits one command, then confirms. Define stable plan/command identity and deterministic commit order without creating a second simulation clock.

criteria.commit: Confirm/edit/cancel requests are idempotent and execution order follows authored policy rather than UI order.
criteria.ownership: pause-timescale owns time policy and downstream action/navigation/combat systems own execution semantics.
